text:
ira: heads-up — saw a cluster of duplicate streaming charges after proxy pool tweak. spike started ~2026-03-23T18:40Z :frowning:
tina: which tweak? we changed idle/keepalive heuristics earlier today
ira: reduced idle_close and enabled aggressive probe on some proxy hosts. traces show client reconnect with same resume token but runtime created a new billable session
jamal: sample trace:
```
[proxy] 2026-03-23T18:39:59Z conn=aa probe=keepalive timeout -> RST
[client] 2026-03-23T18:40:00Z reconnect resume=rt-900 fp=sha1:abc
[runtime] 2026-03-23T18:40:00Z resume=rt-900 marked_stale -> new_session billable
```
sonya: ops: quickest mitigation is FF revert of aggressive probe. longer fix: runtime treat recent-stale resume as non-billable reattach when fingerprint matches
mikhael: agree. add console dedupe window to avoid alert storms while we roll fix. also audit logs for attach events so billing can reconcile retroactively
jamal: runtime pseudo: `if token.exists() && recent(token.last_seen) && fp==token.fp { attach_nonbillable() } else { create_billable() }` — will gate behind FF and add metric `resume.reattach`
tina: will prepare proxy FF to revert to previous probe timing if canary misbehaves. ops wants a 10% canary first
ira: CS already pinged about potential overcharges. mikhael please coordinate console banner for SREs and add dedupe_window=20s to streaming-heartbeat alerts
deploy-bot: deploy requested: canary/runtime/reattach-recent-window -> queued on eng-runtime-canary
sonya: I'll draft rollout steps and a rollback checklist. follow-up: e2e that simulates probe->rst->resume to catch this class of races
ira: thanks team. monitoring: watch resume.reattach, billing.delta and active_sockets_per_resume. will update after first canary batch :pray:
